subject: One of value in the loc.dic is Inf

messages.author: 4e772844ba134054
messages.subject: One of value in the loc.dic is Inf
parts:
Dear all,

The DIC of my inla model is Infite. Then I checked output$loc.dic and found out there is one value which is inf.
It gives finite DIC after I removed that point from my data.
Does anyone understand why?
I am new to R-INLA. Any help will be much appreciated.

Wendy

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] One of value in the loc.dic is Inf
parts:
What happens normally, is that the uncertainty is so high that it runs into overflow. As it integrates that out.  You may check if there is something weird going on with that datapoint , otherwise , you can try to tighten up priors to see if it is going away 

Sent from my iPhone
